audit_items.proof_trace: TOCTOU race condition exists between deduplication check (L157) and cache update (subscriber_data_column_sidecar.go:42). If two identical data column sidecars arrive concurrently, both can pass the hasSeenDataColumnIndex check before either updates seenDataColumnCache, causing duplicate processing despite the spec requirement for first-sidecar-only acceptance.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker broadcasts identical data column sidecar to multiple peers simultaneously. Two validation goroutines both check hasSeenDataColumnIndex at L157 before either calls setSeenDataColumnIndex, both return ValidationAccept, both execute downstream processing including ReceiveDataColumn and reconstruction logic, potentially consuming excess resources or causing state inconsistency.
